name: phpunit

artifact.contents: Unmodified official standalone PHAR, including its bundled dependencies and notices as supplied upstream.

verification.phar_internal_signature_note: The internal PHAR hash checks archive integrity; publisher verification is recorded separately.

openpgp.verification_result: Detached signature retained but not cryptographically verified: the official maintainer GitHub key endpoint returned an empty export stating this key could not be exported. Artifact SHA-256 was verified against the official publisher checksum over HTTPS.

launcher_contract: The wrapper selects upstream PHAR CLI mode using SCRIPT_NAME and excludes itself from PHPUnit process-isolation includes. PHPUnit PHAR defines __PHPUNIT_PHAR__; PHPUNIT_COMPOSER_INSTALL is not defined. A direct require_once of this artifact from another entrypoint loads PHPUnit types without running its CLI.
